[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) - Bullish sentiment strengthened by RSI recovery above 40 and Higher Low pattern, but maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to low volume and resistance from mid-term moving averages.
